verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents agent access to the account. AgentOS, its MCP server and the CLI let agents read balances and build cashflow reports, and the CLI exposes a broad slice of the API for scripting, so an agent could plausibly pull balance data. Nothing in the pack shows payout or settlement records, a balance-transaction ledger, or any way to tie a bank deposit to its underlying charges. Missing for 10: documented settlement/payout report API, balance-transaction line items linking deposits to charges, a reconciliation workflow or skill, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
